第一卷 荒原的奇迹 FS003 魔法卷轴
“啊！法师先生，你怎么还没逃走？”
虽然有些不明白张允说的什么意思，但是阿莱格拉对于张允未逃走的事实，显得十分焦急。
站在阿莱格拉身边，张允这才发现阿莱格拉十分美丽，淡栗色的披肩短发，脸蛋虽然如同花猫一般却很美丽，一双灵动的眼睛虽有惊恐，却也不失纯真与顽皮。被树枝灌木划破的衣服，更是让她多了一份楚楚动人的气质。纤细的双腿微微发颤，显然是受到七级魔兽阶位镇压！
“我要是走了，你怎么办？”张允微微向前一步，挡在了阿莱格拉前面。
七级魔兽疾风贪狼脑袋微微歪着，细细的打量着他。似乎有些不明白这么弱小的人类，挡在自己面前有什么用？
挡在疾风贪狼面前，仅仅是中位高级魔法师的张允却丝毫不惧！
疾风贪狼诧异的看着张允，实在不明白眼前这个弱小的人类为何对它怡然不惧。
想不明白的疾风贪狼摆出准备进攻的架势，寒光闪闪的狼爪十分锋利，能够轻易将人类的身躯抓成几半！
“哼！畜生始终是畜生！即使是七级魔兽！”张允冷哼一声。
七级魔兽属于高阶魔兽，已经开启灵智，拥有不俗的智慧。可惜，依旧是兽性十足！
疾风贪狼能够听懂人言，听见张允骂它畜生，更是恼怒。猛地一下就朝张允扑了过去。它跃身而起时，张开了血盆大口。它口中一颗颗急速旋转的微缩暴风团对准张允疾射而去！
面对七级魔兽的攻击，张允半步未退，从无尽之空中拿出一个魔法卷轴，激发之后，一个半透明的水幕将他和阿莱格拉罩住。
“畜生，七级魔法水幕守护你应该认识吧？”张允嘿嘿一笑，然后又拿出一个魔法卷轴。
这个卷轴呈现土黄色，散发出一股沉重的魔法气息。
“七级魔法，泥沼术！”
土黄色的卷轴化成一道黄光，射向地面。方圆两公里范围内，原本坚实的地面变得泥泞不堪，泥沼中，一股奇异的引力，牵引着疾风贪狼向下沉去！
“呜~~~呜~~~~”
疾风贪狼长嚎两声，四爪生风，踏在空中。它蔑视的看向张允，狼脸上浮现出人性化的嘲讽表情！
“嘿嘿！”张允并不理会疾风贪狼的嘲讽，又拿出一个火红的卷轴。

“七级魔法，怒焰滔天！”
火红色的卷轴化作一道红光射向天空，原本晴朗的天空立刻变得赤红一片。随后，一道道炽热的火焰从天而降，方圆两公里范围内，无差别打击！
四周本来葱葱郁郁的树林消失，只剩下一片焦土！
密集的火焰中，疾风贪狼撑起一个蛋形风壁，显然七级魔法并没有伤害到它！
“嘿嘿！看你能撑多久！”张允冷笑道，随后又从无尽之空中取出一捆卷轴来。不但有土系、火系卷轴，其他各系的均有！
“七级魔法，螺旋水枪！”
“七级魔法，极寒冰弹！”
“七级魔法，裂空之箭！”
……………
各种各样的七级魔法层出不穷，原本还惊讶的阿莱格拉已经变得麻木不仁，只是用怪物的眼光看向张允。
七级魔法卷轴价值不下十万金币，而短短几分钟内，张允至少抛出去三十个七级魔法卷轴！
这可是三百万金币啊！
普通的平民，舒舒服服的享受一年仅仅需要一千金币而已！
那边，挨轰的疾风贪狼十分郁闷！
前几天，它的老窝被一个从天而降的法师塔占领了。它本想反抗，可是法师塔的主人太过牛比，直接吓得它逃之夭夭。
本来打算来安赫瑞尔山脉边缘散散心，没有想到又被人打伤了左前腿！
接二连三的倒霉事碰上它，现在又被不知道哪里冒出来的怪胎，用魔法卷轴狂轰滥炸，它连想死的心都有了！
‘吗的啊，那是魔法卷轴，不是大白菜啊！不带一丢一萝筐的！’疾风贪狼心中哀嚎不已，如此奢侈的用魔法卷轴，这和它了解到的人类不同啊！
将一大捆魔法卷轴丢完后，张允没看见身后目瞪口呆的阿莱格莱，也没感受到疾风贪狼的憋屈，又从无尽之空中取出一大捆卷轴来！
这些卷轴是当初魔武世界中存下来的，当初的文森－奥古斯丁作为神话级强者，哪里需要七级魔法卷轴？

眼看张允又拿出一捆魔法卷轴，阿莱格拉翻了翻白眼，显然已经选择了无视。
对面的疾风贪狼却是郁闷坏了！
‘这家伙骂我是畜生，我看他才是畜生啊！’疾风贪狼有苦说不出啊。
眼看张允又要开始扔卷轴，飓风贪狼高呼道：“人类，投降！投降！”
“啥？”
张允一愣，魔武世界中，可没有这种投降的概念啊？
“人类，我，投降，投降，臣服，你，主人！”七级魔兽的灵智刚启，人类语言说的断断续续的，好在勉强能够表达出它的意思来。
“你的意思是，你要臣服我？”张允试探的问道，手中的卷轴并没有放下。
如今，他只有中位高级魔法师的实力，如果能有一个相当于传说级的打手、恶仆、小弟、保镖兼坐骑，那还是挺不错的啊！
“是是是！我，投降，臣服！”疾风贪狼散开保护自身的飓风之壁，低眉顺耳的匍匐在张允不远处。
‘态度倒是挺端正的！’张允心中思考了一会，‘咦，怎么忘了那玩意！’
张允看着乖巧温顺的疾风之狼，嘿嘿直笑，笑得疾风之狼害怕极了，呜呜呜的低声哀嚎。
从无尽之空中取出一枚小巧的指环，这枚指环也是以前留下来的。
契约之光：能够与一只魔兽签订稳固的主从契约，魔兽最高等级不超过七级。超过七级的魔兽，将签订平等契约。
带上契约之光指环，用魔力激活指环后，奇异的魔纹构成了一个魔法阵，射向疾风贪狼的额头。
疾风贪狼摄于张允卷轴的银威，无可奈何的让魔法阵印刻在了额头之上。当魔法阵完全融入之后，冥冥之中，一道看不见的连接，将疾风贪狼和张允联系了起来。
一道漂亮的弯月形状蓝色魔法符文出现在疾风贪狼额头处，疾风贪狼温顺的向前几步，匍匐在张允的脚下，用它那硕大无比的脑袋讨好的拱着张允的腿部。

content_en:
Volume 1 Miracle of the Wasteland FS003 Magic Scroll
"Ah! Mr. Mage, why haven't you escaped yet?"
Although she didn't understand what Zhang Yun meant, Allegra seemed very anxious about the fact that Zhang Yun had not escaped.
Standing next to Allegra, Zhang Yun realized that Allegra was very beautiful, with short light chestnut shawl hair, a face that was as beautiful as a tabby cat, and a pair of smart eyes that were frightened but still innocent and naughty. The clothes that were scratched by branches and shrubs gave her an even more charming temperament. The slender legs were trembling slightly, obviously suppressed by the seventh-level monster!
"What will you do if I leave?" Zhang Yun took a slight step forward and stood in front of Allegra.
The seventh-level monster Gale Greedy Wolf tilted his head slightly and looked at him carefully. It seems that some people don't understand what is the use of such a weak human being standing in front of him?
Standing in front of Gale Greedy Wolf, Zhang Yun, who is only a mid-level senior magician, is not afraid at all!
Gale Wind Tanlang looked at Zhang Yun in surprise, and really didn't understand why the weak human in front of him was not afraid of it.
The confused Gale Greedy Wolf put up a posture ready to attack. Its gleaming wolf claws were very sharp and could easily cut a human body into half!
"Hmph! A beast will always be a beast! Even if it is a seventh-level monster!" Zhang Yun snorted coldly.
Level 7 monsters are high-level monsters that have opened their spiritual intelligence and possess considerable wisdom. It's a pity that he is still full of animality!
Gale Greedy Wolf can understand human speech, and it became even more angry when Zhang Yun called it a beast. Suddenly he rushed towards Zhang Yun. When it jumped up, it opened its bloody mouth. The rapidly rotating miniature storms in its mouth were aimed at Zhang Yun and shot away!
Facing the attack of the seventh-level monster, Zhang Yun did not take a step back. He took out a magic scroll from the endless sky. After activating it, a translucent water curtain covered him and Allegra.
"Beast, you should know the seventh-level magic water curtain guardian, right?" Zhang Yun chuckled, and then took out another magic scroll.
This scroll is earthy in color and exudes a heavy magical aura.
"Seventh level magic, quagmire!"
The earthy yellow scroll turned into a yellow light and shot towards the ground. Within a radius of two kilometers, the originally solid ground became muddy. In the swamp, a strange gravitational force pulled the Gale and Greedy Wolf downwards!
"Woo~~~Woo~~~~"
Gale Wind Greedy Wolf howled twice, its four claws generated wind, and stepped on the air. It looked at Zhang Yun with contempt, and a humanized expression of ridicule appeared on the wolf's face!
"Hey!" Zhang Yun ignored Gale Greedy Wolf's taunt and took out another fiery red scroll.
"Seventh level magic, raging flames!"
The fiery red scroll turned into a red light and shot into the sky, and the originally clear sky immediately turned red. Then, streaks of blazing flames fell from the sky, striking indiscriminately within a radius of two kilometers!
The lush woods all around disappeared, leaving only a piece of scorched earth!
In the dense flames, Gale Greedy Wolf propped up an egg-shaped wind wall. Apparently the seventh-level magic did not harm it!
"Hey! Let's see how long you can last!" Zhang Yun sneered, and then took out a bundle of scrolls from the endless sky. There are not only earth and fire scrolls, but also scrolls from other types!
"Seventh level magic, spiral water gun!"
"Seventh level magic, extremely cold ice bullet!"
"Seventh level magic, Sky-Splitting Arrow!"
……………
All kinds of seventh-level magics emerged one after another. Allegra, who was originally surprised, had become indifferent and just looked at Zhang Yun with the eyes of a monster.
The seventh-level magic scrolls are worth no less than 100,000 gold coins, and in just a few minutes, Zhang Yun threw out at least thirty seventh-level magic scrolls!
This is three million gold coins!
Ordinary civilians only need one thousand gold coins to enjoy comfortably for a year!
Over there, the blasted Gale Greedy Wolf TenVery depressed!
A few days ago, its nest was occupied by a mage tower that fell from the sky. It wanted to resist, but the master of the Mage Tower was so awesome that it was frightened and ran away.
I originally planned to come to the edge of the Angelil Mountains to relax, but I didn't expect that my left front leg was injured again!
A series of bad luck happened to it, and now it was bombarded with magic scrolls by freaks who didn't know where it came from. It even wanted to die!
‘Yeah, that’s a magic scroll, not cabbage! No one without a basket! ’ Gale Greedy Wolf wailed in his heart, using magic scrolls so extravagantly, this is different from what it knows about humans!
After throwing away a large bundle of magic scrolls, Zhang Yun took out another large bundle of scrolls from the endless sky without seeing the dumbfounded Allegrai behind him, nor feeling the frustration of Gale Greedy Wolf!
These scrolls were preserved from the original world of magic and martial arts. As a mythical powerhouse, how could Vincent Augustine need seventh-level magic scrolls?
Seeing Zhang Yun take out another bundle of magic scrolls, Allegra rolled her eyes, obviously choosing to ignore it.
On the opposite side, Gale Greedy Wolf was extremely depressed!
‘This guy called me a beast, but I think he is the beast! ’ Gale and Greedy Wolf are suffering so much that they can’t describe it.
Seeing that Zhang Yun was about to start throwing the scroll again, Hurricane Greedy Wolf shouted: "Humans, surrender! Surrender!"
"What?"
Zhang Yun was stunned. In the world of magic and martial arts, there is no such concept of surrender?
"Human, I, surrender, surrender, surrender, you, master!" The seventh-level monster's intelligence has just awakened, and the human language is intermittent, but fortunately it can barely express its meaning.
"You mean, you want to surrender to me?" Zhang Yun asked tentatively, without putting down the scroll in his hand.
Now, he only has the strength of a mid-level high-level magician. It would be pretty good if he could have a legendary-level thug, evil servant, younger brother, bodyguard and mount!
"Yes, yes! I, surrender, surrender!" Gale Wind Greedy Wolf spread out the hurricane wall that protected itself, and prostrated not far from Zhang Yun with a low eyebrow.
‘The attitude is quite correct! ’ Zhang Yun thought for a while, ‘Hey, why did you forget that thing! ’
Zhang Yun looked at the well-behaved and docile Gale Wolf and laughed. The laughter made the Gale Wolf so scared that he whined in a low voice.
He took out a small ring from the endless sky. This ring was also left behind from before.
Light of Contract: Ability to sign a solid master-slave contract with a Warcraft. The maximum level of the Warcraft does not exceed level seven. Warcraft above level seven will sign an equality contract.
Wearing the light ring of contract and activating the ring with magic power, the strange magic patterns formed a magic circle and shot towards Gale Greedy Wolf's forehead.
The silver power that Gale Greedy Wolf photographed on Zhang Yun's scroll had no choice but to have the magic circle mark engraved on his forehead. When the magic circle was completely integrated, an invisible connection somehow connected Gale Greedy Wolf and Zhang Yun.
A beautiful blue magic rune in the shape of a crescent moon appeared on the forehead of Gale Greedy Wolf. Gale Greedy Wolf meekly took a few steps forward, crawled at Zhang Yun's feet, and used its huge head to flatter Zhang Yun's legs.
